mapper.sql: d.id, d.doc_no, d.kind, d.order_id, d.source_doc_id, d.partner_id, d.warehouse_id, d.biz_date, d.salesman_id, d.replenish, d.whole_discount, CASE WHEN d.order_id IS NULL THEN d.invoice_kind ELSE o.invoice_kind END AS invoice_kind, d.order_discount, d.freight, d.freight_bearer, d.carrier_supplier_id, d.freight_settle, d.freight_account_id, d.total_qty, d.total_amount, d.remark, d.dept_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, o.order_no, o.source AS order_source, sd.doc_no AS source_doc_no, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) AS partner_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, cs.name AS carrier_supplier_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name

FROM scm_trade_draft d LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id LEFT JOIN scm_trade_doc sd ON sd.id = d.source_doc_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON d.kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND sp.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer cu ON d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND cu.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier cs ON cs.id = d.carrier_supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by
